adaptations: Header render callbacks retain the original native View/ref, children and one live isHovered field.
Native PointerEvent objects replace DOM HoverEvent objects, matching the existing native Button callback boundary; no synthetic public event is created.

Original native View pointer routing and existing input/floating-window eligibility replace DOM containment/document listeners. Native resize/hover/window delivery and all installed/profile proof remain open.
One component-local helper shares pointer lifetime across existing header, row and cell hosts; row CSS paint remains independent of selection/action admission.

Cell render callbacks receive raw native Cell values; only the children function receives defaultChildren. Default and custom paths use the same public NativeFocusView and preserve opaque keyboard/collection props.

A Table-local target ref bridge refreshes cell/column/row metadata registration without detaching a stable consumer ref. Physical target and caller-ref changes retain ordinary cleanup and registration ownership.

Body render and empty callbacks receive committed isEmpty/isDropTarget values through the original View/ref and collection children; drop-target stays false under the existing private non-DnD boundary.

Complete Table-specific logical collection projects source tableheader/tablebody, leaf columns, header rows, row-only navigation, expansion, spanning-cell validation, cell-based filtering and row-header text from the original immutable native snapshot. Original descriptor identities, caller values/props/renderers and native refs remain unchanged.

The full eleven-field TableState uses the existing owned selection/controlled state with pinned grid focus retirement, exact sorting requests, expansion and keyboard-navigation control. Renderer, runtime and exposed state share the same actual collection/manager.

Existing native null-aware zero/empty-key navigation and missing-key null returns remain intact; the new actual React oracle retains upstream filtered-previous-key and header-only failures as source observations, not qualification passes.

Shared selectable props, styles, refs and cell filtering follow the pinned inner merge; the context is reset inside the table, and nested cell content restores the default renderer. Source ignored typeahead/virtual-focus flags remain ignored.

Metadata-generated columns now retain their original supplied IDs. Existing native default test IDs remain stable. Private scalar/query fixtures use unique keys and matching cell counts; their original behavioural assertions are retained.

The private raw Table props context merges after wrapper-owned calibration and before selection/options/metadata construction, then the existing shared selectable context merges inside. Raw context sort/action defaults and current query bridge callbacks retain the canonical merge order. Wrapper-specific metadata/appearance/query controls are not promoted into that raw context.

Default/custom root rendering uses the same public NativeFocusView with original refs, children and opaque collection/input bindings. All four root render fields include the actual complete filtered Table state, never a selection DTO. Original native target focus events and the existing same-window modality registry replace DOM useFocusRing observations.

Source slot-null drops context props/refs while retaining the mounted generated/authored root ID. A component-local committed ID fallback supplies that native identity without introducing a DOM ID registry or modifying shared/native identity protocols.

Existing native text-style context carries table/body/row/cell inherited typography with final authored precedence. Header name Text deliberately retains the canonical b10 bold rule; column-specific styles can override it. Unsupported source key callback extras are observations, not new Table APIs or passing acceptance.

Canonical Motion-wrapped Row render callbacks receive all seventeen raw values and final original native host/ref/collection/keyboard/projection props through a private final-host visual callback. TableRow always uses the public NativeFocusView for default and custom paths; unrelated motion consumers retain their original default host.

Rows retain the distinct independent CSS pointer paint and interaction-eligible render/callback hover states. Original native press/focus/key/hover events preserve current collection admission, owner callbacks and action/selection ownership. Non-DnD isDragging/isDropTarget values remain undefined, matching the actual pinned source rather than claiming drag construction.

Original passive native focus-within receipts and existing input modality provide descendant visibility independently of logical selection-manager focus. All original native/default/focus/AT/measurement/projection/raster/profile acceptance remains required.

Column has its distinct nine raw render values, child/style defaults and real sort/startResize methods, independent of Cell. Original native host/ref/metadata/children survive caller renderer replacement. Missing-container errors and held source sort descriptors are preserved.

A private resizable container supplies actual native onLayout width to the unchanged installed pure sizing hook. Its nine-field state retains the actual native Table state and collection, with original controlled/uncontrolled/fraction/percentage behavior. Existing CUI manual resize remains16 units; raw resize requests use the source10 units and RTL mapping.

The raw five-field resize handle uses original owned focus/key/responder/action hosts and a real clipped accessible one-unit native range view. Localized labels, value text and semantics belong to that original view; no opacity-zero accessibility hiding or model-only field substitutes it. Native-specific window/unmount retirement clears only its owned resize/navigation state without a stale owner callback/focus.

Native expansion/filter projections share unchanged immutable column/header nodes/arrays. This preserves actual metadata identity and prevents the installed resize hook from repeatedly setting lastColumns on native immutable shell recreation. Filtered rows and owner state remain current; no manager or width model is copied.

When the resize container participates, actual sizing-state widths also size body cell spans, replacing the native flexible-row approximation while preserving non-resizable/manual layouts. Original native/default/keyboard/focus/AT/geometry/raster/interop/profile acceptance remains required.
